stage0010_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0010_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0010_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Bridge

stage0010_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Command Center ～

stage0010_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We've been completely outplayed.
　And here I crushed the enemy's research
　facility just to prevent this...」

stage0010_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「There is still hope.
　The $$プリベンター$$ agent the Colonel arranged
　in advance, and $$ウルズ$$ 7, are aboard.」

stage0010_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「According to the last report, they used
　the chaos to escape the plane successfully.」

stage0010_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But we're still at an overwhelming disadvantage.」

stage0010_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It seems that terrorist group itself
　was a decoy.」

stage0010_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All of this is part of the mastermind's plan...
　Hanka Autonomous Region is just one more pawn.」

stage0010_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「An enemy beyond what we imagined, then...」

stage0010_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So this enemy took four hundred hostages
　just to kidnap a single person, and chose
　a site where rescue is politically difficult.」

stage0010_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Using the tired old terror tactic of
　hijacking, and using it quite skillfully.」

stage0010_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Major... what are the odds, would you say,
　that the hostages are freed peacefully?」

stage0010_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Excluding $$千鳥かなめ$$, you mean?」

stage0010_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right.
　If we don't make a careless move, the other
　four hundred besides $$かなめ$$ may be safe.」

stage0010_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「True, the Hanka Autonomous Region government
　surely doesn't want the situation to
　grow more tense either.」

stage0010_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「If it goes badly, there's also a chance the
　Earth Federation Forces might intervene.」

stage0010_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Though in the worst-case scenario, there's
　also the chance Hanka Autonomous Region
　is in league with Neo Zeon.」

stage0010_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I think we can rule that out.
　I don't believe $$ハマーン・カーン$$ is that foolish.」

stage0010_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「So once diplomacy brings the hostages back,
　we should search for and rescue $$かなめ$$.」

stage0010_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「This is unconfirmed, but from the footage
　the $$プリベンター$$ agent sent over earlier,
　the hijackers' leader appears to be $$ガウルン$$.」

stage0010_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「He's assassinated over thirty dignitaries
　and bombed aircraft on two occasions.
　An extremely dangerous man.」

stage0010_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「And he's a sworn enemy to Sergeant Sagara
　and me as well.」

stage0010_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「At the time, he and I were fugitives
　from the $$人革連$$, and
　$$ガウルン$$ was one of our hunters.」

stage0010_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「While we were away, he led two ASes
　and struck the guerrillas' village.
　...It was wiped out.」

stage0010_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「We swore revenge.
　I served as a decoy while Sergeant Sagara
　sniped him, and we brought him down.」

stage0010_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「A brutal man, then.
　This may mean we can't expect the
　hostages to be released after all...」

stage0010_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's against men like $$ガウルン$$ that we
　most need to show our strength.」

stage0010_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「If it's him... if it's Sergeant Sagara,
　he's sure to open some kind of breakthrough.」

stage0010_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Dog 1, who was already undercover in
　the Hanka Autonomous Region, is also
　headed for the scene.」

stage0010_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But the enemy might be an organization that
　knows of the $$ウィスパード$$ and has the power
　to exploit one...」

stage0010_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「If my fears prove right, we may need
　to make use of that after all.」

stage0010_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「The $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$.」

stage0010_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it...!
　Who'd have thought they'd hijack an
　entire jet just to snatch one girl!」

stage0010_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So this $$千鳥かなめ$$ girl is worth
　that much to them...」

stage0010_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Her family: father, a mother who passed away,
　a sister... Her dad's supposedly a Federation
　bureaucrat, but not a very high-ranking one.」

stage0010_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$クラン$$
「So there's a reason she herself is
　being targeted, is that it...」

stage0010_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アルト$$
「That doesn't matter right now!
　The problem is how we save everyone
　at Jindai High!」

stage0010_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アルト$$
「I know that much myself...!
　But still...!」

stage0010_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$エマ$$
「I understand you're anxious, since it's
　your classmates who are in danger.」

stage0010_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$エマ$$
「But if we make a careless move, it will
　only provoke the enemy...
　Understand that.」

stage0010_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$葵$$
「Hmm... I figured playing high schooler
　was just a cover for guarding that
　$$千鳥かなめ$$ girl...」

stage0010_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$葵$$
「But seems you've grown attached to your
　classmates too.」

stage0010_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$葵$$
「I'm not teasing you.
　Having that kind of passion
　fires us up too.」

stage0010_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Still, to think the Dancouga Nova
　pilots were kids about the same age
　as all of you...」

stage0010_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Each of us had our own reasons.」

stage0010_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$葵$$
「Well then, let's introduce ourselves properly.
　I'm $$飛鷹葵$$...
　Took a break from modeling, doing Team D now.」

stage0010_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$くらら$$
「$$館華くらら$$.
　Same as $$葵$$, I'm on leave from narcotics
　work to focus on this instead.」

stage0010_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$朔哉$$
「I'm $$加門朔哉$$.
　A journalist-in-training by trade.
　Though I'm on break too, same as everyone.」

stage0010_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$ジョニー・バーネット$$.
　Normally I'm a talent manager, but...」

stage0010_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Since I'm on hiatus, my manager $$ジョニー$$
　is in the same boat.」

stage0010_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カツ$$
「The idol, $$エイーダ・ロッサ$$...!」

stage0010_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Yes.
　To fight as a member of Team D,
　I put my idol work on hold.」

stage0010_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$カツ$$
「So that's what was behind last week's
　hiatus announcement...」

stage0010_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So why is it you're cooperating with $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0010_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$葵$$
「That part was decided between $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ and
　the higher-ups at $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0010_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$くらら$$
「Apparently $$ミスリル$$ and Dancouga Nova
　clashed a few times before the
　$$破界事変$$.」

stage0010_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Dancouga sides with whoever's losing
　in a fight, and $$ミスリル$$ protects world
　peace in the shadows, bound to collide...」

stage0010_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So ever since then, $$ミスリル$$ and Dragon's
　Hive have had their eyes on each other...」

stage0010_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「With terror groups running rampant lately,
　$$ミスリル$$ asked us for our cooperation.」

stage0010_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Deep down, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ is someone who wishes
　for world peace and humanity's future too.
　So they agreed to the request.」

stage0010_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's why you all got called up.」

stage0010_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$葵$$
「Seems like $$ミスリル$$'s been gathering
　talent from all sorts of places
　besides just us.」

stage0010_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「According to Major $$カリーニン$$, who's been
　directing our operations, an agent's also
　undercover in Hanka.」

stage0010_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Hanka, huh? Now that's a real headache
　of a place. Feel sorry for whoever
　got sent there.」

stage0010_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$朔哉$$
「We don't know who they are either,
　but the callsign's apparently Dog 1.」

stage0010_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$マオ$$
「I see, that's the Major for you.
　Sending in just the right person.」

stage0010_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah.
　If that guy and $$宗介$$ are both there,
　we've got a shot.」

stage0010_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
（I escaped the plane, exploiting the
　chaos that the braided man caused...）

stage0010_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$宗介$$
（The leader of the hijacking...
　$$ガウルン$$, of all people...）

stage0010_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
Mercenary
「That outfit... a student from the jet.
　How did you even get off the plane...」

stage0010_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「Too soft.
　Your mistake was taking your muzzle
　off the target.」

stage0010_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$デュオ$$
「What are you doing?
　Standing there mute isn't going to get you anywhere.」

stage0010_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宗介$$
「You're the one from back then...」

stage0010_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yo, $$ウルズ$$ 7.
　Looks like you made it out okay.」

stage0010_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$デュオ$$
「It was too chaotic on the jet, so
　let's do introductions here.」

stage0010_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm $$デュオ・マックスウェル$$.
　And Mr. Silent over there is $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$.
　We work with 《$$プリベンター$$》.」

stage0010_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$宗介$$
「《$$プリベンター$$》...
　A special unit under the Earth Federation $$大統領$$?」

stage0010_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Neither of us is a regular member.
　We're more like backup for busy times.」

stage0010_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So this time, it's a joint op with $$ミスリル$$.
　We got on the jet to guard
　that girl, $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0010_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　So the Colonel arranged this.」

stage0010_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Though I did hear $$ミスリル$$ sent an agent
　into the Hanka Autonomous Region too...」

stage0010_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Didn't expect it'd be you... $$キリコ$$.」

stage0010_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm a $$ミスリル$$ mercenary now too.」

stage0010_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Not just $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ here, either.
　We fought alongside your buddies
　$$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$ too.」

stage0010_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Bingo.
　Though back then I was piloting a Gundam.」

stage0010_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$宗介$$
「Handling sabotage work too... so
　you're a colony Gundam pilot.」

stage0010_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Bingo again.
　Though our Gundams got labeled hazardous
　and sealed away somewhere.」

stage0010_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Is this really the time for old stories, $$デュオ$$?」

stage0010_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Fair enough.
　Well... talking to you was never going
　to get much livelier anyway.」

stage0010_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$キリコ$$
「With you two here, this'll go quick.」

stage0010_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, $$ヒイロ$$ and I already disarmed
　the explosives planted on board.」

stage0010_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Now we just clean up the guys inside
　and get this jet moving already.」

stage0010_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Then I'm heading out to rescue $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0010_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's what I'm saying...!
　If you just stay silent like that......」

stage0010_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fine.
　You seem suited for it.」

stage0010_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll be the decoy.
　The woman's likely held in a facility
　three blocks over.」

stage0010_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$デュオ$$
「...Did you use 《$$脳量子波$$》 or something?」

stage0010_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no need for that.」

stage0010_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$宗介$$
「I eliminated whoever was watching this room.」

stage0010_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Doesn't look like you're hurt...
　What did they do to you here?」

stage0010_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I'm not really sure, but,
　they showed me some weird footage...」

stage0010_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-yeah...
　Like sleep-learning, all these science
　terms just kept streaming by...」

stage0010_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The person in charge of me said
　I should already know every one of those words...」

stage0010_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't understand what that means...」

stage0010_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh... now that you mention it...
　that person called me a $$ウィスパード$$...」

stage0010_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ウィスパード$$...
　Does that ring a bell?」

stage0010_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Probably a diversion.
　Let's escape while we can!」

stage0010_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
Mercenary
「Damn it!
　What is that guy!?」

stage0010_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
Mercenary
「It's just one guy!
　Why are we getting wrecked this bad!」

stage0010_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
Mercenary
「Bring the Savage around!
　Shred him with the autocannon!」

stage0010_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
Mercenary
「No way...!
　Even the AS got taken down!」

stage0010_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「An Armor Magnum, huh.
　Guess he's a hardcore Votoms nut.」

stage0010_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Back off.
　Even a hundred of you together
　couldn't beat him.」

stage0010_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I like those eyes.
　That gunsmoke stench you carry chokes me up.」

stage0010_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「No need for introductions.
　You're $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, aren't you?」

stage0010_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Meeting the famous 'Untouchable' out here...
　life's not so bad after all.」

stage0010_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no time to waste on you.」

stage0010_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「So cold!
　Play with me more, Chiricooo!」

stage0010_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
Mercenary
「M-Mister $$ガウルン$$, it's an emergency!
　An intruder's seized control of the jet!」

stage0010_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
Mercenary
「And it seems the girl has also
　been recovered by someone!」

stage0010_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch... useless bunch!
　All you're good for is dragging me down!」

stage0010_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Major, when did you get to the Quarter?」

stage0010_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Just now.
　I have to clean up after this incident.」

stage0010_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「What happened to $$ガウルン$$?」

stage0010_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$宗介$$
「He's dead.
　For good, this time.」

stage0010_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I see...
　I wish I could have been there myself.」

stage0010_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「You look like you have something to say.」

stage0010_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Major, what exactly is a Lambda Driver...?」

stage0010_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$宗介$$
「Even I know a bit of basic physics.
　Never heard of a device wielding power like that.」

stage0010_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「...Your generation, born after
　the 《$$大時空震動$$》, won't feel it,
　but today's weapons tech is abnormal.」

stage0010_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That Lambda Driver, the $$ＥＣＳ$$,
　the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s propulsion system...
　all of it's too advanced.」

stage0010_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Sci-fi-looking robots dominating the battlefield...
　have you never thought that unnatural?」

stage0010_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Today was the first time I thought so.」

stage0010_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I've held this doubt for some time...
　that such things shouldn't exist...
　And yet, here they are.」

stage0010_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「This weapons tech that advanced so fast
　in recent years... who created this black
　technology...? Or where did it come from...?」

stage0010_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Do you know the answer?」

stage0010_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Someone like Chidori?
　The ones called $$ウィスパード$$...?」

stage0010_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's not mine to say.
　But keep it in the back of your mind.」

stage0010_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「How is $$千鳥かなめ$$ doing?」

stage0010_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$宗介$$
「She lost consciousness after the rescue,
　likely from relief. I hear she's now in a
　hospital in $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0010_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 2 and a few others are attending to her,
　but I stayed on the ship to report
　on the situation.」

stage0010_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「As for Chidori, Intelligence will spread
　false information, that $$ガウルン$$'s people
　checked her and she wasn't a $$ウィスパード$$.」

stage0010_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「This should keep her safe for now.」

stage0010_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Still, we need insurance in place.」

stage0010_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...I think I've got a rough idea now
　about Sagara and Miss $$スズネ$$'s situation.」

stage0010_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$マオ$$
「For now, you were drugged at that base,
　and lost consciousness right after...」

stage0010_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$マオ$$
「Next thing you knew, it was this hospital...
　You don't remember anything in between...
　Just forget it all, okay.」

stage0010_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So Sagara belongs to the same
　military as you, called $$ミスリル$$...」

stage0010_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Not a regular army, though.
　More like... an army of justice protecting the world.」

stage0010_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$甲児$$, $$アルト$$, $n, and $$ワッ太$$ are
　all in a similar boat. Sure, it's a world
　an average student wouldn't get, but they try hard.」

stage0010_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That much... I think I understand.」

stage0010_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$マオ$$
「But if you don't want trouble,
　just stick to 'I don't remember a thing'.」

stage0010_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$マオ$$
「...And I need to thank you for something.」

stage0010_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$マオ$$
「No...
　It's thanks to your help that we
　were able to win that battle.」

stage0010_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$マオ$$
「If you hadn't been there,
　$$宗介$$ would've charged in recklessly,
　at the very least. So you saved his life.」

stage0010_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「T-that's not...!
　Now I'm embarrassed, ahahaha.」

stage0010_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$さやか$$...
　And everyone else came too.」

stage0010_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$アルト$$
「We wanted to apologize for keeping
　secrets from you all this time...」

stage0010_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's fine.
　I heard about everyone's circumstances.」

stage0010_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I should be the one apologizing...
　sorry for getting so mad over not knowing!」

stage0010_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Especially you, $l, I'm truly
　sorry for taking it out on you over Sagara!」

stage0010_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$n
「...Thanks to your meddling, I made
　friends... So we're even.」

stage0010_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ahahaha!
　$l and Sagara really make a good team.」

stage0010_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$甲児$$
「Well, let's keep getting along, $$かなめ$$.」

stage0010_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Although, $$宗介$$ will be transferring schools.」

stage0010_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$マオ$$
「Originally, $$宗介$$ only enrolled
　in high school for the mission.
　Now that it's over, it's only natural.」

stage0010_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$アルト$$
「Cheer up.
　It's not like it's goodbye forever.」

stage0010_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Our school trip got ruined,
　but let's first be glad that
　we all made it back safely.」

stage0010_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Correct.
　You should thank the rescue team.」

stage0010_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Furthermore, if you had cooperated,
　the operation would have been
　far easier to carry out.」

stage0010_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$n
「$$宗介$$...!
　When did you get here!?」

stage0010_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll be in your care for a while, Chidori.」

stage0010_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$恵理$$
「Oh, Chidori!
　I'm so glad you're safe!」

stage0010_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$風間$$
「Huh, Miss $$スズネ$$'s group is here too!」

stage0010_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Hey, everyone!
　Sounds like it was rough!」

stage0010_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$詩織$$
「Honestly!
　Saotome and the rest, do you have any idea
　how scared we were!?」

stage0010_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$恭子$$
「That's right!
　Everyone who missed the bus
　was seriously lucky!」

stage0010_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Come on, $$恭子$$, it's fine.
　We all got to see each other again safely.」

stage0010_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's true.
　It was a rough school trip,
　but it's sure to be unforgettable.」

stage0010_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just as Miss $$スズネ$$ says!
　Hahaha! Long live Class 2-4!
　Class 2-4 will live forever!!」

stage0010_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana... after going through
　something that awful, you're
　awfully lively...」

stage0010_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yo...!
　Sounds like you did great out there.」

stage0010_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Good, staying humble.
　Same quiet type as a certain someone,
　but you're a lot more endearing.」

stage0010_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Well then, we confirmed the target's
　safe, so we're heading out.」

stage0010_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Because it was the mission.
　No reason beyond that.」

stage0010_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Really now?
　Isn't it solidarity between kindred spirits?」

stage0010_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, yeah.
　Got it, got it.」

stage0010_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「But it's true that you risked
　your life to save Chidori and me.
　...It's not much, but take this as thanks.」

stage0010_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$宗介$$
「Field rations, Calorie Friend...
　For what it's worth, I prefer the fruit kind.」

stage0010_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$宗介$$
「Where are you two headed next?」

stage0010_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$デュオ$$
「There's a meeting between Vice Minister
　$$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ and Princess $$マリナ・イスマイール$$,
　so we're on escort duty for that.」

stage0010_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$デュオ$$
「See ya, $$ウルズ$$ 7.
　We'll meet again somewhere.」

stage0010_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$宗介$$
「I wish you both good luck.」

stage0010_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$宗介$$, I, $$ＡＧ$$, was truly
　impressed by your performance this time.」

stage0010_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$宗介$$
「I merely carried out my mission.」

stage0010_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no, standing against a mighty foe
　to protect someone dear, that strong will
　is what gives birth to miracles...!」

stage0010_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could such a wonderful drama
　possibly fail to produce Z-Chips!?
　No, it could not!」

stage0010_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of a current high schooler!
　Your classical Chinese lessons are paying off!」

stage0010_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$宗介$$
「...I can't be bothered with this.」

stage0010_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100 Z that Master $$宗介$$ produced,
　I've added to the squad's stock.」

stage0010_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm looking forward to your rematch
　with that man $$ガウルン$$.」

stage0010_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$宗介$$
「That won't happen.
　He's already dead.」

stage0010_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my...
　Quite something, that Lambda Driver...」

stage0010_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The pilot's feelings becoming power...
　truly the technology of dreams...!」

stage0010_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If the $$ジェニオン$$, too, could turn $n's
　emotions directly into power,
　it would surely grow even stronger.」

stage0010_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now... enough daydreaming,
　let's get down to solid work!
　Let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
